title: API documentation
bodyHtml:
This guide provides an overview of available API endpoints for various biomedical research programs. For programs without specific endpoints listed here, please refer to their official documentation for more information.

4D Nucleome (4DN)

The 4D Nucleome program provides reference nucleomics and imaging data sets, along with tools for open data processing and visualization.

  • Website: https://www.4dnucleome.org/
  • Official API Docs: 4DN REST API Guide
  • Data Types: Nucleomics, Genomics, Epigenomics, Imaging

Available API Endpoints

GET: Predicted gene-variant-disease links

This endpoint retrieves predicted links between genes, variants, and diseases.

  • Method: GET

  • Endpoint URL:

    https://cfde.hugeampkpnbi.org/api/bio/query/4dn-gene?q=$tissue,$gene
  • Parameters:
    • $tissue: The tissue type you are querying.
    • $gene: The gene symbol.
  • Data Format: bioindex

Acute to Chronic Pain Signatures (A2CPS)

This program gathers data from patients to understand the transition to chronic pain. It includes imaging, omics, sensory testing, and psychosocial assessments.

  • Website: https://a2cps.org/
  • Official API Docs: Not Available
  • Data Types: Multi-omics (including Genomics, Transcriptomics, Proteomics, Metabolomics), Imaging

Bridge to Artificial Intelligence (Bridge2AI)

Bridge2AI focuses on creating ethically sourced, trustworthy biomedical and behavioral datasets for AI applications. The program is in its early phase.

  • Website: https://bridge2ai.org/
  • Official API Docs: Not Available
  • Data Types: Functional Genomics, Multi-omics, Biomedical & Behavioral Data

Cellular Senescence Network (SenNet)

SenNet is building atlases and datasets of senescent cells. The program is in its early phase, and data generation is ongoing.

  • Website: https://commonfund.nih.gov/senescence
  • Official API Docs: https://docs.sennetconsortium.org/apis/
  • Data Types: Multi-omics (including Genomics, Epigenomics, Transcriptomics, Proteomics, Metabolomics)

RNA Extracellular RNA Communication (exRNA)

This program provides a catalog of exRNA molecules found in human biofluids and explores their potential as disease biomarkers.

  • Website: https://exrna.org/
  • Official API Docs: Not Available
  • Data Types: Transcriptomics (exRNA)

Available API Endpoints

GET: Catalog of exRNA molecules in human biofluids

Fetches counts of exRNA molecules by gene.

  • Method: GET

  • Endpoint URL:

    https://cfde.hugeampkpnbi.org/api/bio/query/exrna-gene-counts?q=$gene
  • Parameters:
    • $gene: The gene symbol.
  • Data Format: bioindex

Gabriella Miller Kids First (KF)

Kids First provides whole-genome sequencing data from cohorts with structural birth defects and childhood cancer, along with phenotypic and clinical data.

  • Website: https://kidsfirstdrc.org/
  • Official API Docs: Not Available
  • Data Types: Genomics, Transcriptomics, Imaging

Available API Endpoints

GET: Gene Variants

Retrieves gene variant data from the Kids First program.

  • Method: GET

  • Endpoint URL:

    https://cfde.hugeampkpnbi.org/api/bio/query/kids-first-gene-variants?q=$gene
  • Parameters:
    • $gene: The gene symbol.
  • Data Format: bioindex

The Genotype-Tissue Expression Project (GTEx)

GTEx provides data to study tissue-specific gene expression and regulation using whole genome and RNA sequence data from multiple human tissues.

  • Website: https://www.gtexportal.org/home/
  • Official API Docs: https://gtexportal.org/home/apiPage
  • Data Types: Genomics, Transcriptomics

Available API Endpoints

GET: Tissue Specificity

Fetches tissue specificity data for a given gene.

  • Method: GET

  • Endpoint URL:

    https://cfde.hugeampkpnbi.org/api/bio/query/gtex-tstat?q=$gene
  • Parameters:
    • $gene: The gene symbol.
  • Data Format: bioindex

GET: Gene Expression Levels

Retrieves gene expression levels across different tissues.

  • Method: GET

  • Endpoint URL:

    https://bioindex-dev.hugeamp.org/api/bio/query/gene-expression?q=$gene
  • Parameters:
    • $gene: The gene symbol.
  • Data Format: bioindex

GlyGen

This project integrates and disseminates data related to carbohydrates and glycoconjugates.

  • Website: https://glygen.org/
  • Official API Docs: https://api.glygen.org/
  • Data Types: Glycomics

Available API Endpoints

GET: Glycan-related Genes

Retrieves data on genes associated with glycans.

  • Method: GET

  • Endpoint URL:

    https://cfde.hugeampkpnbi.org/api/bio/query/glygen-genes?q=$gene
  • Parameters:
    • $gene: The gene symbol.
  • Data Format: bioindex

The Human BioMolecular Atlas Program (HuBMAP)

HuBMAP is an open platform to map healthy cells in the human body to understand how cellular relationships affect health.

  • Website: https://hubmapconsortium.org/
  • Official API Docs: https://smart-api.info/registry?q=hubmap
  • Data Types: Multi-omics (Spatial Transcriptomics, Proteomics, Genomics, Epigenomics, Metabolomics)

Available API Endpoints

GET: Dataset Metadata

Retrieves metadata for all single-cell datasets.

  • Method: GET

  • Endpoint URL:

    https://cfde.hugeampkpnbi.org/api/raw/file/single_cell_metadata/dataset_metadata.json.gz
  • Data Format: line json

GET: Dataset Fields

Retrieves the available data fields for a specific dataset.

  • Method: GET

  • Endpoint URL:

    https://cfde.hugeampkpnbi.org/api/raw/file/single_cell/$datasetId/fields.json.gz
  • Parameters:
    • $datasetId: The ID of the dataset.
  • Data Format: line json

GET: Cell Coordinates

Fetches the coordinates for cells within a specific dataset.

  • Method: GET

  • Endpoint URL:

    https://cfde.hugeampkpnbi.org/api/raw/file/single_cell/$datasetId/coordinates.tsv.gz
  • Parameters:
    • $datasetId: The ID of the dataset.
  • Data Format: line json

GET: Gene Expression

Queries the log-normalized expression data for a specific gene within a dataset.

  • Method: GET

  • Endpoint URL:

    https://cfde.hugeampkpnbi.org/api/bio/query/single-cell-lognorm?q=$datasetId,$gene
  • Parameters:
    • $datasetId: The ID of the dataset.
    • $gene: The gene symbol.
  • Data Format: bioindex

Illuminating the Druggable Genome (IDG)

IDG provides data on understudied druggable proteins to facilitate new drug development.

  • Website: https://druggablegenome.net/
  • Official API Docs: https://pharos.nih.gov/idg/api
  • Data Types: Genomics (Druggable Genome), Transcriptomics, Proteomics

Available API Endpoints

POST: Drug Target Level Classifications

Retrieves detailed information and classifications for a drug target.

  • Method: POST

  • Endpoint URL:

    https://pharos-api.ncats.io/graphql

  • Request Body: This endpoint uses a GraphQL query. The $parameter variable should be replaced with your gene of interest.

    {
  "query": "query targetDetails{ target(q: { sym: \"$parameter\" }) { name tdl fam sym description novelty }}"
}
  • Data Format: JSON

Knockout Mouse Phenotyping Program (KOMP2)

This program provides broad, standardized phenotyping data from a genome-wide collection of mouse knockouts.

  • Website: http://www.mousephenotype.org/
  • Official API Docs: https://www.mousephenotype.org/help/programmatic-data-access/
  • Data Types: Genomics (Mouse Knockouts), Phenomics

Library of Integrated Network-based Cellular Signatures (LINCS)

LINCS contains molecular signatures describing how different cell types respond to various disruptive agents.

  • Website: http://lincsproject.org/
  • Official API Docs: https://clue.io/api
  • Data Types: Transcriptomics, Proteomics, Multi-omics (Cellular Signatures)

Available API Endpoints

GET: Cellular Signatures

Retrieves data on network-based cellular signatures related to a specific gene.

  • Method: GET

  • Endpoint URL:

    https://cfde.hugeampkpnbi.org/api/bio/query/lincs-corr?q=$gene
  • Parameters:
    • $gene: The gene symbol.
  • Data Format: bioindex

Molecular Transducers of Physical Activity in Humans (MoTrPAC)

MoTrPAC provides data related to the molecular changes that occur in response to physical activity.

  • Website: https://motrpac-data.org/data-access
  • Official API Docs: https://motrpac-data.org/api/data-api/introduction
  • Data Types: Multi-omics (Genomics, Epigenomics, Transcriptomics, Proteomics, Metabolomics)

Available API Endpoints

POST: Differential Abundance Data

Retrieves differential abundance data for a given gene. Note: This endpoint requires an authentication token.

  • Method: POST

  • Endpoint URL:

    https://search.motrpac-data.org/api/beta/differential-abundance
  • Parameters:
    • $gene: The gene symbol.
  • Headers:
    • Content-Type: application/json
    • Authorization: bearer $auth_token (Replace $auth_token with your valid token).
  • Data Format: JSON lines

Stimulating Peripheral Activity to Relieve Conditions (SPARC)

SPARC provides maps and tools to understand the neural circuitry of organs and tissues for therapeutic purposes.

  • Website: https://sparc.science/
  • Official API Docs: https://docs.sparc.science/docs/sparc-api-overview
  • Data Types: Neuroscience Data, Anatomical Data, Electrophysiology, Transcriptomics

Other Programs

The following programs did not have specific API endpoints listed in the provided data. Please visit their official websites for more information on data access.

  • H3Africa: https://h3abionet.org/
  • Human Microbiome Project (HMP): https://commonfund.nih.gov/hmp
  • Integrated Human Microbiome Project (iHMP): https://hmpdacc.org/ihmp/
  • Metabolomics Workbench: https://www.metabolomicsworkbench.org/
  • Somatic Mosaicism Across Human Tissues (SmaHT): https://commonfund.nih.gov/smaht
  • Undiagnosed Diseases Network (UDN): https://undiagnosed.hms.harvard.edu
